name: Kaiki Gensou Yume Monogatari Kaijuu Kidan Oboro Juuya
original_name: 怪奇幻想夢物語 怪獣綺譚 朧十夜
source:
The nation of Itaru is shielded by four legendary beasts
representing the sky, the earth, the day and the night.
Here people are given birth as a girl with no exceptions,
and later choose to become either man or a woman.

This is a story of siblings who shoulder a fate to see the truth...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE215237.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
伊达尔国受到代表天空、大地、白昼与黑夜的四只传说之兽庇护。这里的人无一例外都以女性之身出生，之后可以选择成为男性或女性。

这是一个由兄妹共同背负命运、追寻真相的故事……
